title: Mukteshwar & Kainchi Dham
reportingPoint: Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time: 10:30 PM on the departure night.
overview:
Two kinds of calm in one weekend: this **1 Night / 2 Days** group trip pairs the views of Mukteshwar with a visit to Kainchi Dham. You leave Delhi at night from Vaishali Metro Station (reporting 10:30 PM) and arrive in Mukteshwar the next morning.

Day 1 has a short 1.5 km hike to a local waterfall, then Chauli ki Jali and the Mukteshwar Temple, and ends with a bonfire, music and dinner at your Swiss camp or room. Day 2 visits Kainchi Dham, followed by sightseeing in either Nainital or Bhimtal, before the bus leaves for Delhi at 9:00 PM. Prices start at ₹5,199 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi at night
itinerary.content:
Board the bus or traveller from Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi.
Reporting time: 10:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mukteshwar
itinerary.content:
Morning: arrive in Mukteshwar and check in to your camps or rooms.
Afternoon: a short 1.5 km hike to a local waterfall. After the hike, visit Chauli ki Jali and the Mukteshwar Temple, known for their views and cultural significance.
Evening: return to your stay for a bonfire and music session. Dinner, followed by an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Adventure, Kainchi Dham and sightseeing
itinerary.content:
Morning: after breakfast, check out and try the adventure activities (at your own cost).
Afternoon: visit Kainchi Dham. Later, proceed to either Nainital or Bhimtal for leisurely sightseeing.
Evening: depart for Delhi at 9:00 PM.
Next day, early morning: arrival in Delhi.

importantNotes:

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: You board the AC bus or traveller at Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time is 10:30 PM on the departure night, and you reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Mukteshwar and Kainchi Dham trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹5,199 per person on quad sharing, ₹5,399 on triple sharing and ₹5,599 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

faqs.q: When do we visit Kainchi Dham?
faqs.a: On Day 2, in the afternoon, after breakfast and check-out. The group then goes on to either Nainital or Bhimtal for sightseeing and leaves for Delhi at 9:00 PM.
Round-trip transfers from Delhi, 1 night in Swiss camps or rooms, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner and an evening high tea, sightseeing as per the itinerary, a bonfire and music evening, and a trip captain.
No. Adventure activities on Day 2 are optional and paid for separately, as are entry tickets and personal expenses.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
